disposition.reason: This docket appeals the Colchester Planning Commission's denial of site plan approval, a municipal land-use decision, but the proposal is to use an existing single-family house as a boarding house for multiple tenants with no changes to the structure, a change of occupancy without construction, which is not new housing.

evidence.quote: denying his application for site plan approval to convert a single family residence to a boarding house
No changes to the structure have been made.
The Planning Commission denied site plan approval and Appellant appealed to this Court.
multiple tenants (running a boarding house without Planning Commission approval)

judgments.note: Appeal of a Planning Commission site plan denial (municipal appeal yes); the use sought is renting an existing four-bedroom house to multiple tenants as a boarding house, with no structural changes, which the guide's housing table classes as a change of occupancy or tenants without construction (housing no), so the case is excluded.
Appellant appealed the Planning Commission's denial of site plan approval to the Environmental Court.
Boarding-house use of an existing house; the decision states no changes to the structure have been made and no construction or new unit is proposed.

history.note: Excluded: appeal of site plan denial for boarding-house use of an existing house without construction.
